question: Does the runtime query-form check reject malformed requests, and what does it cost in false rejections?

benchmark.description: every query the benchmark generator produced; well formed by construction, so any refusal is a false rejection
rejected_queries: According to the table in the source document, what is the Sufficient thinking ("If… then") for What to change to??
According to the table in the source document, what is the Computer Systems for What to change to??

hand_authored_well_formed.description: well-formed queries written to include the cases the benchmark's own filter rejects -- acronym, hyphen, gerund, bare keyword, statement, and out-of-domain but well formed

hand_authored_malformed.description: malformed queries written by hand, with the reason each is malformed; two keyboard mashes are expected misses, because the check has no dictionary and no language model

harvested_stems.description: the question stems the benchmark generator emits and rejects, harvested from the corpus and labelled by hand; the only population of malformed text not written by the author of the rule
missed_malformed_queries: What is an example of this?
What are gathering Time series data and cross-sectional data?
What value is stated for this number had grown to in the source documentation?
What is the assumption that demand?
What value is stated for are at a distance in the source documentation?
What value is stated for in examinations with no additional machines in the source documentation?
What value is stated for if the buffer in the source documentation?

counterfactual_benchmark_rule.description: what a runtime check that reused the benchmark's own `_subject_is_usable` filter would have done to the same stems; the filter is a rule about subjects, so it is evaluated on the subject
false_rejected_examples: What are the required parameters to the solution?
What is national Incoterms chambers Incoterms 2020?
What value is stated for deviation in the source documentation?

cost.note: the check runs before retrieval, so a request it refuses costs no embedding pass, no cross-encoder pass and no model call
